name: Royal Dollar
oneLiner: RUSD is RIB / Royal Coins' centralized dollar stablecoin backed by issuer-managed cash and short-term liquid reserve assets with KYC-gated mint and redemption.
collateral: Issuer-managed fiat reserve assets and short-term liquid instruments disclosed by Royal/R Coins materials
pegMechanism: Centralized 1:1 dollar token with issuer-managed mint and redemption processes for approved users

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: RUSD deploys the same non-upgradeable Circle-style FiatToken (RoyalDollar) on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Tron, with no cross-chain functions of any kind in the contract — no LayerZero OFT/CCIP/Wormhole/Axelar hooks, only mint/burn governed by MASTERMINTER/MINTER roles (independently confirmed by reading the verified Ethereum and BSC contracts). The identical Eth/BSC address is a deterministic vanity deploy, not an omnichain token standard. Each chain's supply is minted independently by the issuer's per-chain mint authority (Eth/BSC MASTERMINTER 0xc50ebe57; Tron 0x9a0c5f3a), so there is no durable cross-chain token bridge; the "R-Bridge / RxBridge" is a hybrid Bank–OTC–Exchange business settlement network, not an on-chain supply route.

genius.notes: RUSD has issuer-style stablecoin disclosures, but no public GENIUS approval or foreign-issuer exception source was found. RIB Group Holdings Ltd / RIB Digital operates from Hong Kong/UK; no OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, or state regulatory filing identified. The foreign-issuer exception framework itself remains in proposed-rules phase as of 2026-06-18 with no registered exceptions granted to any issuer.

mintAuthority.summary: RUSD is issued by RIB / Royal Coins (Hong Kong) via non-upgradeable token contracts. On Ethereum and BSC the MASTERMINTER and DEFAULT_ADMIN is EOA 0xc50ebe57 (same issuer EOA as REUR); on Tron the MASTERMINTER is a separate EOA (0x9a0c5f3a in EVM notation, same Tron EOA as REUR).

controls.label: RIB Digital issuance EOA — Ethereum and BSC (MASTERMINTER + DEFAULT_ADMIN)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295037, owner() on 0x44bb433d29fe966992a9c812da7f252c9c53f285 returned 0xc50ebe57ae937a8ac0bcaab8945777c3be54a511; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xc50ebe57) = true; hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0xc50ebe57) = true. Contract is not upgradeable (no proxy-admin or impl slots). BSC: same address and same owner confirmed at BSC block 103629529.

controls.label: RIB Digital issuance EOA — Tron (MASTERMINTER + DEFAULT_ADMIN)
controls.evidence: On Tron, owner() on TUvns399UpycBBpVsCVJLCjXFBjzHrNUR1 (EVM 0xcff568886f655cf6) returned 0x9a0c5f3a73fafb8bd7e7c4c8295cdd8daa87f692; eth_getCode via Tron JSONRPC = 0x (EOA). hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0x9a0c5f3a) = true. Same Tron EOA as REUR Tron.
